summary: Oculis Holding AG filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held May 13, 2026. Shareholders approved all agenda items including annual report, discharge of directors, re-election of board members, election of Gregory D. Perry to the board, auditor and proxy appointments, compensation for board and executive committee, and a capital band amendment. This is a routine annual meeting disclosure with no special-situation transaction. The filing is a standard foreign issuer report under Rule 13a-16; there are no deal terms, prices, or strategic changes beyond ordinary governance matters. No further action warranted.
